title: DCT
text: Discrete cosine transform (DCT) of input, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Rounding mode} sets Rounding mode; {Sine and cosine computation}, {Saturate on integer overflow}, {Sine table}, {Product output}, {Accumulator}, {Output} sets the data type of output, {Output Minimum}, {Output Maximum} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input 1
ports.summary: Input signal vector | matrix | N -D array

ports.name: Output 1
ports.summary: DCT output vector | matrix | N -D array

params.name: Sine and cosine computation
params.values: Sine and cosine computation Table lookup (default) | Trigonometric fcn

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Saturate on integer overflow off (default) | on

params.name: Sine table
params.values: Sine table Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16)

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
